tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅// yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga chos dang bsod nams rgyas byed bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga chos dang bsod nams rgyas byed ces bya ba/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dmigs med snying rje'i chu gter che las 'khrungs// byang chub sems kyi dge ba'i sbrang rtsis gtams// thabs mkhas spyod pa'i 'dab stong rab rgyas pa// rgyal ba chu skyes dbang por rab btud nas// bsod nams tshogs chen rdzogs par bya phyir dang*// yid 'ong gzugs sku'i 'bras bu thob bya'i phyir// dam pa'i chos dang bkra shis rgyas byed lam// yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga gsal bar bshad// 'dir thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa thob par 'dod pa'i gang zag skal ba dang ldan pa dag gis/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rlabs po che rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir/ 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa'i mdo dang*/ mchog gi spyod pa'i smon lam las gsungs pa ltar/ yan lag bdun pa rgyas par byed par 'dod na/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum gyi dang po ni/ dkon mchog gi rten na bzas brgyan pa'i spyan sngar/ mchod yon dang*/ mar me dang*/ zhal zas rnams kyi phreng ba du ma dang*/ me tog dang*/ bdug spos dang*/ dri chab rnams ci 'byor pa bsham/ sngon gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dag rang la longs spyod gang yod kyi sum gnyis dkon mchog gi mchod pa la gtong dgos par bzhed pa ltar/ longs spyod la ser sna med cing*/ gzhan gyis mthong na blo 'khul nus pa'i mchod pa bsham mo// de nas rab tu dma' ba'i stan la 'dug la/ dkon mchog gi rten la kha phyogs pas/ thog mar skyabs 'gro bya ste/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes mang du brjod pa'i mthar/

sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i 'di dag gis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis skyabs gnas mthar thug pa dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la yan lag bdun pa 'bul bar bgyi'o snyam du sems bskyed nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang dus rtag tu mi 'bral bar gyur cig chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad mchod pa'i yul du spyan drangs par bsams la/ pus btsugs thal mo sbyar bas me tog dang bdug spos bzung la/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyang zhing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i// khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'dir lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// yang dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// zhes brjod cing*/ dkon mchog rnams byon pa'i sngon gdong du dmigs la langs te/ phyogs dus kun nas skyabs gsum bka' sdod bcas// nyon mongs 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs nas// dpag med zhing nas thogs med rdzu 'phrul gyis// 'dir gshegs mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus bzhugs gsol// zhes pas so so'i zhing khams nas byon pa'i dkon mchog rnams mdun du mngon sum ltar bzhugs par bsams nas/

khyed ni rang bzhin yongs dag pas// sred sogs nyes pa mi mnga' yang*// bdag cag sgrib pa sbyang slad du// gtsang ma chab kyis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin brlabs ye shes chu yis ni// ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod// rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa sbyang slad du// rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// sems can lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa dag gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa dus mas sku khrus gsol// zhes dang*/ rkang pa re re'i gsham du sngar gyi sngags rnams brjod cing*/ me long gi nang du dkon mchog gi rten 'chang du bcug pa la dri bzang po'i chus khrus gsol/ de nas/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥkā ya bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes chu'i rdul rnams dar dkar po la dri bzang gi thig le lnga'am rigs lnga'i sa bon bris pas phyi zhing*/ sku phyis par bsgoms la/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra ba// gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur gyur pa// gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul// bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta was+t+ra a laṃ ka ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ dri med mtshan la sgrib bsal mi mnga' yang*// dad pas ngur smig rgyal mtshan phul ba yis// nam mkha'i mthar thug gyur pa'i sems can rnams// sangs rgyas brtul zhugs mchog la spyod par shog /ces khrus dang gos rgyan gyi mchod pa rnams phul nas/

bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid pas// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// oṃ pad+ma tsan+d+ra ā sa na tiṣ+ṭhan+tu swā hā/ zhes pas gdan dbul lo// de nas rol mo dang bcas pas bskor ba bya zhing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ rat+na ke tu rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samya k+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ rat+ne rat+ne/ ma hā rat+ne/ rat+na bi dza ya swā hā/ zhes brjod do// gnyis pa la/ yan lag bdun gyi dang po phyag 'tshal ba'i yan lag ni/ sems kyis lus zhing rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam par sprul pa'i lus re re la mgo dpag tu med pa/ mgo re re la'ang lce brgya stong dpag tu med par bsams la/ de thams cad gyis phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ bstod pa brjod par bsgoms la/ ngag tu bstod tshig rnams brjod/ lus kyi gnas lnga sa la gtugs pa'i phyag byas la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// mkhyen brtse yon tan phrin las ma lus pa// gcig tu bsdus nas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa// dpal ldan bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod ni sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong 'byung ba'i gnas// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun kun gyi 'dren pa ste// dpal ldan bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// skyob pa sangs rgyas kun dang gnyis su med// legs gsungs sgron me dam pa'i chos kyi gsung*// ston pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen mchog /rin chen bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma mnyam med sangs rgyas rin po che// dus gsum bde gshegs sras bcas thams cad kyis// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor byin brlabs pa// bka' drin chen po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// bsod nams ri bo mi 'gyur brtan pa'i sku// gsung dbyangs thos pas mi ngoms tshangs pa'i dbyangs// ye shes rgya mtsho mi g.yo zab pa'i thugs// bla ma'i sku gsung thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul bla chen sa skya pa// bsod nams rtse mo rje btsun rin po che// chos rje paṇa chen chos rgyal 'phags pa sogs// bstan pa'i sgron me rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sogs kyis bla ma rnams dang*/

tshogs chen gnyis rdzogs mkhyen bzhi sku gsum grub// rnam rtog mi mnga' ci yang sa ler gzigs// chos sku mkha' 'dra gzugs sku mdzes skur ldan// sangs rgyas dpag bsam 'dra la phyag 'tshal lo// chos nyid rgyu mthun gsung rab bcu gnyis dang*// chos la skye 'gag med cing spros pas dben// de la dmigs te yon tan kun 'byung ba'i// legs rgyu dam pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo// nyon mongs sgrib dang shes bya'i sgrib pa dag /gnyen pos rim par bsal nas zhing sbyong zhing*// sems can thams cad sangs rgyas sar gzhug pa'i// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun che la phyag 'tshal lo// ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che// skyob pa bla med dam chos rin po che// 'dren pa bla med dge 'dun rin po che// bla med dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog bla med dpal mgon rin po che// dad mos rnams la yon tan bsam mi khyab// mtho dman yongs kyi skyabs gnas 'gro ba'i mgon// rin chen dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// sku gsum bdag nyid thub pa'i dbang po dang*// dug gsum nad sel chags bral dam pa'i chos// bslab gsum rnam dag 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la// sgo gsum gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sogs kyis dkon mchog spyi dang*/ chos sku nam mkha' lta bur dbyer med kyang*// gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal// thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gtsug tor thams cad skyob// 'khor ba 'jig dang gser thub 'od srungs dang*// shākya thub pa gau tam lha yi lha// sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun la phyag 'tshal lo// bskal pa grangs med 'das pa'i dus kyi tshe// phongs gyur 'gro ba mtha' dag bskyab pa'i phyir// smon lam khyad par can btab 'grub gyur pa'i// bde bar gshegs pa brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs bcu'i 'gro la mkhyen brtses rab dgongs nas// phyogs bcur chos kyi 'khor lo legs bskor bas// phyogs bcu'i 'gro kun yongs su skyob mdzad pa'i// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sngon gyi smon lam byang chub rjes spyad pas// mtshan tsam thos pas sgrib pa kun sel ba'i// phrin las mnga' ba kun mkhyen 'jig rten mgon// sangs rgyas sum cu lnga la phyag 'tshal lo// mthun pa'i smon lam dge tshogs rmad byung zhing*// spyad pa spyod tshe na yang mched gyur cing*// bskal bzang gcig la mdzad pa mthar phyin pa// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong la phyag 'tshal lo// thabs mkhas thugs rjes shākya'i rigs 'khrungs shing*// gzhan gyis mi thub bdud kyi dpung bcom pa// gser gyi lhun po lta bur brjid pa'i sku// shākya'i rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam dag sku mnga' mchog tu gzugs bzang ba// ye shes rgya mtsho gser gyi lhun po 'dra// grags pa 'jig rten gsum na lham me ba// mgon po mchog gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mtshan mchog ldan pa dri med zla ba'i zhal// gser mdog 'dra ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rdul bral khyod 'dra srid pa gsum ma mchis// mnyam med mkhyen can khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig ma lus rkang gnyis gtso// dus gsum bde gshegs kun gyi ngo bo nyid// gser gyi mdog can lha yi lhar gyur pa// dam tshig gsum bkod rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje kun la snyoms pa'i bcom ldan 'das// mtshan tsam thos pas ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal sel// dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla// bai ḍūr+ya yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med// dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms pa'i dpal// mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs// sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sogs kyis bye brag sangs rgyas dkon mchog dang*/

smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba'i bstan pa mkha' ltar yangs pa'i lam// don dam dmigs med spros pa kun las 'das// dbyangs kyi mtshan tsam kun mkhyen ngo bo nyid// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sogs kyis chos dkon mchog dang*/ 'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs// sa yi snying po sgrib pa rnam par sel// nam mkha'i snying po byams pa kun tu bzang*// nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba kun gyi thugs las 'khrungs pa'i sras// byang chub spyod pa bla med mthar phyin pas// shākya'i rgyal po'i rgyal tshab mchog gyur pa'i// mgon po mi pham pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rga sha'i 'jigs spangs gzhon nur gyur pa ste// gzhan don byas pas 'dzum pa'i bzhin ras can// sna tshogs sprul mdzad 'od zer mtha' yas pa// bcom ldan 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje gcig bsdus pa// spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten gsum gyi rje// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus dpyis 'byin pa// thugs rje chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gang la nyon mongs rnams kyang bde sbyin na// gang zhig gus bcas de la ci smos pa// mthu chen sman pa'i rgyal po lta bu yi// byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// nyin dang mtshan mo de bzhin lan gsum du// byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gus phyag 'tshal// rtag tu 'dod bzhin spyad pa spyod pa na// de dag 'khrul pa tsam yang mi btsal lo// zhes sogs kyis byang sems dang*/ brtse bas thugs rje'i dbang phyug nyid kyi sku// drang srong chen po'i tshul du bstan nas kyang*// 'gro ba'i gdung ba drag po sel mdzad pa// bcom ldan seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba nyid kyang thugs rje'i dbang gis ni// lha mo'i tshul ston kun tu gsal ba'i sku// yid bzhin nor bu pad+ma legs bsnams pa// shes rab pha rol phyin la phyag 'tshal lo// lha dang klu dbang grub pa'i cod pan gyis// rin chen 'od zer 'phro ba gang gi zhabs// kun nas gsal bas nyi ma'ang zil gnon pa// phongs pa kun skyob sgrol ma'i zhabs la 'dud// brtse bas rjes chags pad+ma rā ga'i mdog

/zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis mdzes pa'i sku// mda' gzhu ut+pal dbang gi lcags kyu 'dzin// bcom ldan rigs byed ma la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba 'jigs pas nyen pa bskyab pa'i phyir// brtse bas 'jigs byed khro mo'i skur ston pa// dbugs 'byin mdzad cing dngos grub mchog stsol ma// sgrol ma drag mo 'dul la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog /zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku// ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma// rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// ma rgad mdog mtshungs nyi ma lta bur gsal// nyon mongs dug 'joms rma bya'i mjug sgro dang*// dngos grub kun stsol bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin// rma bya chen mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis mtshan tsam 'dzin cing dran pas kyang*// bar du gcod pa kun las grol mdzad cing*// dri med bde ba chen po stsol mdzad ma// lha mo 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi// cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa las byung ba'i// lha mo gang gis bsgrubs pas nad gdon bgegs// kun nas zhi mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo// gang thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi// rdo rje rin chen kun nas 'bar ba'i mthus// bdud bzhi'i stobs rnams rnam par 'joms pa yi// rdo rje rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo// chos dbyings rang bzhin in+d+ra nī la'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs zung brjid pa'i sku// ye shes ral gri rdo rje zhags pa bsnams// khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal chen nam mkha'i mdog gi mdangs ldan zhing*// dus mtha'i sprin ltar hūm̐ sgra 'brug stong chem// 'bar ba'i rdo rjes bgegs kyi klad 'gems pa'i// phyag na rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ma lus rgyal ba'i gnyis med ye shes las// nye bar bsgrubs pa'i mthu stobs rdo rje yis// bgegs kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par 'joms byed pa// dpal chen rig sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rjes gdug pa 'dul phyir rab khros pa// bye ru'i mdog mtshungs pad+ma'i dbyug to 'dzin// rta mchog zhal gyis dgra yi dpung 'joms pa// khro rgyal rta mgrin dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba kun gyi gsung rab rgya mtsho yi// rnam par 'phrul pa'i dpal las legs 'ong zhing*// sgrub pa po la blo gros mchog ster ma// lha mo dbyangs can ma la phyag 'tshal lo// 'byung lnga'i mdog can 'byung chen lnga la dbang*// kun tu sgyur byed rdo rje'i 'dab gshog can// klu yi dpal 'phrog lha mi'i dpal gyur pa// rdo rje nam mkha' lding la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sogs kyis 'dod lha rnams dang*/

gang la sems kyi dam pa rin chen de// skyes pa de yi sku la phyag 'tshal zhing*// gang la gnod pa byas kyang bde 'brel ba// bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la skyabs su mchi// dgra bcom blo mchog dbang po kun dul ba// bstan pa'i srid du legs par brtan bzhugs nas// bstan pa 'dzin dang spel dang srung mdzad pa'i// dgra bcom gnas brtan bcu drug zhabs la 'dud// zab mo rten 'brel bcu gnyis legs bsgoms pas// rang byung rang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes ni// gtan pa med pa'i tshul gyis thugs chud pa'i// 'phags pa rang rgyal rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rdzu 'phrul stobs dang mngon par shes par dpal// nye bar thob nas thub pa'i bka' bzhin du// bstan pa rin chen bang mdzod legs 'dzin pa'i// rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gang sngon sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i dge bsags pas// tshe dang nor dang mthu yi dpal brnyes nas// sgrub pa po la dbyig gi char 'bebs pa// nor sbyin rnams la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sogs kyis dge 'dun dkon mchog rnams la phyag byas la/ slar yang*/ mkha' ltar khyab pa'i rgyal ba sras bcas la// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa// lus 'di zhing rdul mnyam par rab sprul nas// rtag tu gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sogs kyis phyag bya'o// gnyis pa mchod pa 'bul ba'i yan lag ni/ mdun du bshams pa'i mchod pa rnams lha rdzas las byung pa'i mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ sa gzhi khyab pa tsam du gyur par bsams nas de dag dang*/ gzhan yang phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi mchod yon la sogs pa thams cad 'bul ba'i bsam pa rtse gcig pas/ phyogs dus kun na mchod yon ci mchis rnams// dkon mchog gsum la phul bas 'gro ba kun// don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i// byang chub sems kyis sems rgyud brlan par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/

sngags mgo mjug gnyis po 'og ma rnams la yang sbyar la/ phyogs dus kun na me tog ci mchis rnams// dkon mchog gsum la phul bas 'gro ba kun// gnas skabs mthar thug bde ba'i 'bras 'byung ba'i// sbyin pa'i me tog phyogs bcur rgyas par shog /badz+ra puṣ+pe/ phyogs dus kun na bdug spos ci mchis rnams// dkon mchog gsum la phul bas 'gro ba kun// 'phags pa dgyes shing 'gro kun bde byed pa'i// tshul khrims dri zhim rgyun mi 'chad par shog /badz+ra dhū pe/ phyogs dus kun na snang gsal ci mchis rnams// dkon mchog gsum la phul bas 'gro ba kun// nyon mongs sdug bsngal mun pa kun sel ba'i// bzod pa'i sgron me rab tu rgyas par shog /badz+ra ā lo ke/ phyogs dus kun na dri mchog ci mchis rnams// dkon mchog gsum la phul bas 'gro ba kun// skyo ngal med par gzhan don la spro ba'i// brtson 'grus byug pa'i sems dang ldan par shog /badz+ra gan+dhe/ phyogs dus kun na zhal zas ci mchis rnams// dkon mchog gsum la phul bas 'gro ba kun// zag med bde bas lus sems tshim byed pa'i// bsam gtan zas la rtag tu spyod par shog /badz+ra nai wi d+ya/ phyogs dus kun na sil snyan ci mchis rnams// dkon mchog gsum la phul bas 'gro ba kun// zab cing rgya che'i chos don ston pa yi// shes rab sgra snyan phyogs bcur sgrogs par shog /badz+ra shab+da/ 'khor lo nor bu btsun mo blon po dang*// glang po rta mchog dmag dpon rin chen bdun// dkon mchog gsum la phul bas 'gro ba kun// 'phags pa'i nor bdun rnams la spyod par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sap+ta ma hā rat+na badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ phyogs dus kun na yid 'ong gzugs sgra dang*// dri ro reg bya khyad 'phags 'dod yon lnga// dkon mchog gsum la phul bas 'gro ba kun// ye shes lnga ldan rgyal ba'i sku thob shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañca kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dza te āḥhūm̐/

phyogs dus kun na bdag pos ma bzung ba'i// yid 'ong mchod pa'i yo byad ci mchis rnams// dkon mchog gsum la gus pas 'bul lags kyi// bdag gi don slad nyid kyi mthus bzhes shig /dad dang snying rje'i shugs kyis bdag gi lus// 'gro kun phan bde'i bya ba bsgrub slad du// dkon mchog gsum gyi bran du legs phul nas// dngos sam bsam pas gzhan don ci nus bgyi// rin chen bum pa dri zhim spos kyi chu// srab 'jam yang zhing mdzes pa lha yi gos// rin chen sna tshogs rgyan phreng yid du 'ong*// bla med dkon mchog gsum la gus pas 'bul// kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong me tog phreng*// dri zhim nam mkha' khyab byed bdug pa'i sprin// mun sel rin chen sgron me lham me ba// bla med dkon mchog gsum la gus pas 'bul// rnam dag dbang po tshim byed dri yi mchog /kha dog dri ro nus bzang lha yi gos// rnam thar don ston glu dbyangs rol mo'i sgra// bla med dkon mchog gsum la gus pas 'bul// sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras pa'i gzhal med khang*// rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can// bla re rgyal mtshan 'phan sogs khyad 'phags rnams// bla med dkon mchog gsum la gus pas 'bul// zhes pa'i mthar/ na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi sa twe bh+yaḥ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā brta ya ā brta ya swā hā/ zhes brjod par bya ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod pa dang*/ bsnyen bkur dang*/ zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas par 'gyur ro// de nas maṇ+ḍal khru gang las mi chung ba'am/ sa gzhi la me tog dang bcas pa'i dri bzang pos phyogs thams cad du khyab par byug cing*/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐ zhes pas rin po che'i sa gzhi dang*/ mtha' skor du byug cing*/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas lcags ri'i khor yug tu bsams la/ hūm̐ zhes pas dbus su me tog dor te bsrung bar byas nas/

rang rang gi gnas rnams su me tog gam/ rin po che la sogs pa dbul zhing*/ dbus dang phyogs bzhir/ oṃ haṃ su me ra we na maḥ oṃ yaṃ pūrba bi de hā ya na maḥ oṃ raṃ dzam+bu dwī pā ya na maḥ oṃ laṃ a ba ra go dā nī yā ya na maḥ oṃ waṃ ut+ta ra ku ra we na maḥ zhes pas/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho dzam+bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan rnams dang*/ rtsa ba'i gling rnams dang nye ba na/ oṃ yuḥ.u pa dwī pā ya na maḥ oṃ raḥ.u pa dwī pā ya na maḥ oṃ laḥ.u pa dwī pā ya na maḥ oṃ waḥ.u pa dwī pā ya na maḥ zhes lus dang lus 'phags/ rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla rnams dang*/ de dag gi nang du shar la sogs pa'i phyogs bzhi dang*// me la sogs pa'i mtshams bzhir rim pa bzhin/ oṃ yaḥg dza rat+na ya na maḥ oṃ raḥpu ru ṣa rat+na ya na maḥ oṃ laḥpā dzī rat+na ya na maḥ oṃ waḥs+t+rī rat+na ya na maḥ oṃ yaḥkhaḍ+ga rat+na ya na maḥ oṃ raḥtsakra rat+na ya na maḥ oṃ laḥm ṇi rat+tā ya na maḥ oṃ waḥmahā ni dha ye na maḥ zhes pas/ rin po che sna bdun dang*/ gter chen po'i bum pa rnams dang*/ ri rab kyi shar dang nub tu/ oṃ aṃ sūr+yā ya na maḥ oṃ āḥtsan+d+rā ya na maḥ zhes bzlas pas nyi ma dang zla ba dag dang*/ gzhan yang lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pas yongs su gang bar dmigs la/ lhag bsam rnam dag chu gter las 'khrungs gling mangs 'dab ma rab rgyas shing*// ri rab lhun po ze'u 'brus rnam mdzes nyi zla'i 'od kyi mdangs bzang can// 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byor dri bsung rab 'phro nam mkha'i dbyings ltar kun khyab pa'i// rin chen maṇ+ḍal me tog mchog 'di rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// zhes pas phul nas/ don yid la sems bzhin du/ rin chen sems de gzung bar bya ba'i phyir// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang dam pa'i chos// dkon mchog dri ma med dang sangs rgyas sras// yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la legs par mchod// me tog 'bras bu ji snyed yod pa dang*// sman gyi rnam pa gang dag yod pa dang*// 'jig rten rin chen ji snyed yod pa dang*// chu gtsang yid du 'ong ba ci yod dang*// rin chen ri bo dang ni de bzhin du// nags tshal sa phyogs dben zhing nyams dga' dang*// ljon shing me tog rgyan spras spud pa dang*// shing gang 'bras bzang yal ga dud pa dang*// lha sogs 'jig rten na yang dri dang ni// spos dang dpag bsam shing dang rin chen shing*// ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo tog rnam pa dang*// mtsho dang rdzing bu pad+mas brgyan pa dang*// ngang pa shin tu skad snyan yid 'ong ba// gzhan yang mchod par 'os pa'i rgyan rnams dang*// nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyi mthas gtugs pa// yongs su bzung ba med pa de dag kun// blo yis blangs nas thub pa skyes bu mchog

/sras dang bcas pa rnams la legs 'bul na// yon gnas dam pa thugs rje che rnams kyis// bdag la brtser dgongs bdag gi 'di dag bzhes// bdag ni bsod nams mi ldan bkren can te// mchod pa'i nor gzhan bdag la cang ma mchis// des na gzhan don dgongs pa'i mgon gyis ni// bdag gi don slad nyid kyi mthus bzhes shig /rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni// bdag gi lus 'di gtan du dbul bar bgyi// sems dpa' mchog rnams bdag ni yongs bzhes shig /gus pas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi// bdag ni khyod kyis yongs su bzung bas na// srid na mi 'jigs sems can phan par bgyi// sngon gyi sdig las yang dag 'da' bgyid cing*// sdig pa gzhan yang slan chad mi bgyid do// khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa// shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar// rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan// mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa der// de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa dus mas sku khrus gsol// de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o// de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul// gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*// rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag gis// 'phags pa kun tu bzang dang 'jam dbyangs dang*// 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs la'ang brgyan par bgyi// stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi// dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang rnams kyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi// thub dbang mchod gnas mchog la yid 'ong ba'i// me tog man+da ra dang pad+ma dang*// ut+pal la sogs dri zhim thams cad dang*// phreng ba spel legs yid 'ong rnams kyis mchod// spos mchog yid 'phrog dri ngad khyab pa yi// bdug sprin sna tshogs rnams kyang de la dbul// zhal zas bza' btung sna tshogs bcas pa yi// lha bshos rnams kyang de la dbul bar bgyi// gser gyi pad+ma tshar du dngar ba yi// rin chen sgron me rnams kyang dbul bar bgyi// sa gzhi bstar ba spos kyis byugs pa der// me tog yid 'ong sil ma dgram par bgyi// gzhal med pho brang bstod dbyangs yid 'ong ldan// mu tig rin chen rgyan 'chang mdzes 'bar ba// dpag g.yas nam mkha'i rgyan gyur de dag kyang*// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can la dbul bar bgyi// rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can// khor yug rgyan gyi rnam pa yid 'ong ldan// dbyibs legs lta na sdug pa bsgreng ba yang*// rtag tu thub dbang rnams la dbul bar bgyi// de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan// sems can sdug bsngal sim byed pa// sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig

/dam chos dkon mchog thams cad dang*// mchod rten rnams dang sku gzugs la// rin chen me tog la sogs char// rgyun mi 'chad par 'bab par shog /ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas// rgyal ba rnams la mchod mdzad pa// de bzhin bdag gis de bzhin gshegs// mgon po sras dang bcas rnams mchod// yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la bdag /bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos bstod// bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag la// nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig /ces pas mchod par bya'o// gsum pa sdig pa bshags pa'i yan lag ni/ sngar byas pa'i sdig pa la 'gyod pa drag po dang*/ phyis mi byed pa'i sdom sems dang ldan pas/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas 'khor ba thog ma ma mchis pa nas tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du 'dod chags dang*/ zhe sdang dang*/ gti mug gi dbang gis lus dang*/ ngag dang*/ yid kyi sgo nas mi dge ba bcu bgyis pa dang*/ mtshams med pa lnga bgyis pa dang*/ de dang nye ba lnga bgyis pa dang*/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya dang 'gal ba dang*/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba dang*/ dkon mchog gsum la gnod pa'i las bgyis pa dang*/ dam pa'i chos spong ba dang*/ 'phags pa la skur pa btab pa la sogs pa mdor na mtho ris dang thar pa'i gegs su gyur cing*/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyur gyur pa'i nyes ltung gi tshogs ci bgyis pa de dag thams cad bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so// mi 'chab bo// mi sbed do// slan chad kyang sdom par bgyid lags so// mthol zhing bshags na bdag bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur gyi/

ma mthol ma bshags na ni de ltar mi 'gyur ba lags so// zhes dang*/ phyogs rnams kun na bzhugs pa yi// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems// thugs rje chen po mnga' rnams la// thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni// thog ma med ldan 'khor ba nas// tshe rabs 'di'am gzhan dag tu// bdag gis ma 'tshal sdig bgyis pa'am// bgyid du stsal ba nyid dang ni// gti mug 'khrul pas bdag non te// rjes su yi rang gang bgyis pa// nongs pa de ni mthong bgyis nas// bsam pa thag pas mgon la bshags// bdag gis dkon mchog gsum dang ni// pha ma'am bla ma gzhan dag la// nyon mongs sgo nas lus ngag dang*// yid kyis gnod bgyis gang lags dang*// nyes pa du mas skyon chags pa'i// sdig can bdag gis sdig pa gang*// shin tu mi bzad bgyis pa de// thams cad 'dren pa rnams la bshags// bdag ni sdig pa ma 'byang bar// sngon du 'gums par 'gyur du mchi// 'di las ji ltar nges thar bar// myur ba'i tshul gyis bskyab tu gsol// yid brtan mi rung 'chi bdag ni// byas dang ma byas mi sdod pas// na dang mi na kun gyis kyang*// glo bur tshe la yid mi brtan// thams cad bor te cha dgos pas// bdag gis de ltar ma shes nas// mdza' dang mi mdza'i don gyi phyir// sdig pa rnam pa sna tshogs byas// mi mdza' rnams kyang med 'gyur zhing*// mdza' ba rnams kyang med par 'gyur// bdag kyang med par 'gyur ba ste// de bzhin thams cad med par 'gyur// rmi lam nyams su myong ba bzhin// dngos po gang dang gang spyad pa// de de dran pa'i yul du gyur// 'das pa thams cad mthong mi 'gyur// re zhig gson tshe 'di nyid la// mdza' dang mi mdza' du ma 'das// de dag don du byas pa'i sdig /mi bzad gang yin mdun na gnas// de ltar bdag ni glo bur zhes// bdag gis rtogs par ma gyur pas// gti mug chags dang zhe sdang gis// sdig pa rnams pa du ma byas// nyin mtshan sdod pa med par yang*// tshe 'di rtag tu god 'gyur zhing*// bsnon pa gud nas yod med na// bdag lta 'chi bar cis mi 'gyur// bdag ni mal na 'dug bzhin du// gnyen bshes rnams kyis mtha' bskor kyang*// srog gcod pa yi tshor ba dag

/bdag nyid gcig pus myong bar 'gyur// gshin rje'i pho nyas zin pa la// gnyen gyis ci phan bshes ci phan// de tshe bsod nams gcig bskyab na// de yang bdag gis ma bsten to// mgon po bag med bdag gis ni// 'jigs pa 'di 'dra ma 'tshal nas// mi rtag tshe 'di'i ched dag tu// sdig pa mang po nye bar bsgrubs// skye bo yan lag gcod pa'i sar// de ring khrid pa'ang bred gyur te// kha skam mig rtsa ngan la sogs// snga las gzhan du 'gyur snang na// gshin rje'i pho nya 'jigs 'jigs lta'i// sha tshugs can gyis bzung 'gyur zhing*// 'jigs chen nad kyis theb gyur pa// rab tu nyam thag smos ci dgos// su zhig 'jigs chen 'di las bdag /legs par skyob par byed 'gyur zhes// bred sha thon pa'i mig bgrad nas// phyogs gzhir skyabs dag tshol bar byed// phyogs bzhir skyabs med mthong nas ni// de nas kun tu yi mug 'gyur// gnas der skyabs yod ma yin na// de tshe bdag gis ci ltar bya// de bas rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon// 'gro ba skyob pa'i don brtson pa// stobs chen 'jigs pa kun sel la// de ring nyid nas skyabs su mchi// de yi thugs su chud pa'i chos// 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la yang*// de bzhin yang dag skyabs su mchi// bdag ni 'jigs pas rnam skrag nas// kun tu bzang la bdag nyid 'bul// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la bdag nyid kyis// bdag gi lus 'di dbul bar bgyi// thugs rje'i spyod pa ma 'khrul ba// spyan ras gzigs mgon de la yang*// nyam thag nga ros 'o dod 'bod// sdig ldan bdag la skyabs tu gsol// 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po dang*// sa yi snying po dag dang ni// thugs rje che mgon thams cad la// skyabs 'tshol snying nas 'o dod 'bod// gang zhig mthong na gshin rje yi// pho nya la sogs sdang ba rnams// skrag nas phyogs bzhir 'byer byed pa// rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi// sngon chad khyed kyi bka' las 'das// da ni 'jigs pa cher mthong nas// khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyi// 'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol// tha mal nad kyis 'jigs na yang*// sman pa'i ngag bzhin bya dgos na// 'dod chags la sogs nyes brgya yi// nad kyis rtag btab smos ci dgos// de gcig gis kyang 'dzam gling na// gnas pa'i mi kun brlag byed na// de dag gso ba'i sman gzhan ni// phyogs rnams kun nas mi rnyed na// de la sman pa thams cad mkhyen// zug rngu thams cad 'byin pa yi// bka' ltar mi byed sems pa ni// shin tu gti mug smad pa'i gnas// g.yang sa tha mal chung ngu la// bag yod gnas par bya dgos na// dpag tshad stong du ltung ba yi// yun ring g.yang sa smos ci dgos// de ring kho nar mi 'chi zhes// bde bar 'dug pa'i rigs ma yin// bdag ni med par gyur pa'i dus// de ni gdon mi za bar 'byung*// bdag la mi 'jigs su yis byin// 'di las ji ltar nges thar 'gyur// gdon mi za bar med 'gyur na// ji ltar bdag yid bde bar 'dug

/sngon chad myong ste zhig pa las// bdag las lhag pa cig yod na// bdag ni de la mngon zhen nas// bla ma'i bka' dang 'gal bar byas// gson tshe 'di dang de bzhin du// gnyen dang bshes pa rnams spangs nas// gcig pur ga shed 'gro dgos na// mdza' dang mi mdza' kun ci rung*// mi dge ba las sdug bsngal 'byung*// 'di las ji ltar nges thar zhes// nyin mtshan rtag tu bdag gis ni// 'di nyid 'ba' zhig bsam pa'i rigs// bdag ni mi shes gti mug pas// rang bzhin kha na ma tho ba'am// bcas pa'i sdig pa gang yin pa// gang yang rung ba bgyis pa rnams// mgon po'i spyan sngar mngon sum du// thal sbyar sdug bsngal 'jigs sems kyis// yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal te// de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi// 'dren pa rnams kyis bdag gi sdig /nongs pa lags par gzung du gsol// 'di ni bzang po ma lags pas// slan chad bdag ni yong mi bgyi// zhes brjod/ bzhi pa dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba'i yan lag ni/ sems can kun gyi ngan song gi /sdug bsngal ngal bso'i dge ba dang*// sdug bsngal can dag bder gnas la// dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo*// byang chub rgyur gyur dge bsags pa// de la rjes su yi rang ngo*// lus can 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las// nges par thar la yi rang ngo*// skyob pa rnams kyi byang chub dang*// rgyal sras sa la yi rang ngo*// sems can thams cad bde mdzad pa'i// thugs bskyed dge ba rgya mtsho dang*// sems can phan par mdzad pa la// dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo*// zhes brjod do// lnga pa chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul ba'i yan lag ni/ phyogs rnams kun gyi sangs rgyas la// thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni// sems can sdug bsngal mun 'thib la// chos kyi sgron me sbar du gsol// zhes brjod/ drug pa mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa'i yan lag ni/ rgyal ba mya ngan 'da' bzhed par// thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni// 'gro 'di mdongs par mi dgod cing*// bskal pa grangs med bzhugs par gsol// zhes brjod do// bdun pa dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba'i yan lag ni/

de ltar 'di dag kun byas te// dge ba bdag gis bsags pa gang*// des ni sems can thams cad kyi// sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar shog /'gro ba nad pa ji snyed pa// nad sos gyur gyi bar du ni// sman dang sman pa nyid dang ni// de yi nad g.yog byed par shog /zas dang skom gyi char phab ste// bkres dang skom pa'i gnod pa bsal// mu ge'i bskal pa bar ma'i tshe// bdag ni zas dang skom du gyur// sems can phongs shing dbul ba la// bdag ni mi zad gter gyur te// yo byad mkho dgu sna tshogs su// mdun na nye bar gnas gyur cig /bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*// dus gsum dge ba thams cad kyang*// sems can kun gyi don bsgrub phyir// phangs pa med par gtang bar bya// thams cad btang bas mya ngan 'da'// bdag blo mya ngan 'das pa bsgrub// thams cad gtang bar chabs cig pa// sems can rnams la btang bas mchog /bdag gis lus can thams cad la// lus 'di ci bder byin zin gyis// rtag tu gsod dang smod pa dang*// rdeg sogs ci dgar byed la rag /bdag gi lus la rtse byed dam// co 'dri ga zha'i rgyu byed kyang*// bdag gi lus 'di byin zin gyis// 'di yi kha tas ci zhig bya// de la gnod par mi 'gyur pa'i// las gang yin pa byed du chug /bdag la dmigs nas nam du yang*// 'ga' yang don med ma gyur cig /bdag la dmigs nas gang dag gis// khro'am dad pa'i shugs phyung nas// de nyid rtag tu de dag gi// don kun 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /gang dag bdag la kha zer ram// gzhan dag gnod pa byed pa'am// de phyir 'phyar ka gtong yang rung*// thams cad byang chub skal ldan gyur// bdag ni mgon med rnams kyi mgon// lam zhugs rnams kyi ded dpon dang*// brgal 'dod rnams kyi gru dang ni// gzings dang zam pa nyid du 'gyur// gling don gnyer la gling dang ni// mar me 'dod la mar me dang*// gnas mal 'dod la gnas mal dang*// bdag ni lus can bran 'dod pa// kun gyi bran du 'gyur bar shog

/yid bzhin nor bu bum pa bzang*// rig sngags grub dang sman chen dang*// dpag bsam gyi ni shing dag dang*// lus can rnams kyi 'dod 'jor shog /sa sogs 'byung ba chen po dang*// nam mkha' bzhin du rtag par yang*// sems can dpag tu med pa yi// rnam mang nyer 'tsho'i gzhir yang shog /de bzhin nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i// sems can khams la rnam kun tu// thams cad mya ngan 'das bar du// bdag ni nyer 'tsho'i rgyur yang shog /ces brjod do// gsum pa rjes ni/ de ltar yan lag bdun pa tshar ba'i rjes la/ dkon mchog gi yon tan rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas mdo rjes dran rnam gsum dag par bton la/ yon tan de dag dang ldan pa'i dkon mchog gsum la byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro bar bsams la/ bud+dha sha ra ṇaṃ gats+tshā mi/ dharmā sha ra ṇaṃ gats+tshā mi/ saṃ ghā sha ra ṇaṃ gats+tshā mi/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pas skyabs 'gro zhe thag pa nas byas pa'i mthar/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa/ bla ma bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa/ da ltar bstan pa 'dzin pa rnams sku khams bzang zhing sku tshe ring ba dang rnam par dkar ba'i phrin las phyogs bcur rgyas pa/ sems can rnams la bde skyid kyi dpal phun sum tshogs shing*/ byang chub kyi sems gnyis rgyud la skyes nas 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims la gnas te/ don gnyis phun sum tshogs pa bsgrub pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa/ 'jig rten du char chu dus su 'bebs shing lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa/ nad dang 'khrugs pa mu ge med cing bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs pa/

khyad par du sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor bcas kyi nad dang gdon dang bar chad zhi ba/ tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba/ dpal dang 'byor pa rgyas pa/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub bde blag tu 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes dang*/ 'gro ba kun gyi tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs shing*// sgrib gnyis bag chags bcas pa rab spangs nas// kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i sku gnyis myur thob ste// don gnyis 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*// rgyal khams kun tu bde skyid 'phel ba dang*// rgyal sras rnams kyis ji ltar dgongs pa'i don// rgya chen 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// sbyin bdag rnams kyi chos dang mthun pa'i don// ji ltar bsams pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*// nad gdon bgegs dang bar du gcod pa kun// nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// lus can kun gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa dang*// 'khrug long gnod 'tshe mtha' dag rab zhi nas// phan tshun phan bde'i dpal la 'god pa yi// dge legs 'phel bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// phyogs rnams kun tu lo phyugs legs pa dang*// longs spyod 'phel zhing sdig pa'i las spangs nas// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems ldan pa'i// chos spyod 'phel bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// mkhyen rab ye shes spyan gyis legs gzigs nas// thugs rje chen po'i phyag gis nyer bzung ste// lhun grub rgyud ldan phrin las nus mthu yis// mkha' mnyam 'gro la byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes drag tu gsol ba btab pa'i rjes su ji ltar rigs pa'i bsngo ba dang smon lam btab la nongs pa bzod par gsol/ der bzhugs pa'i rten rnams la brtan bzhugs dang*/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa ci rigs brjod pa ni cho ga rgyas pa'o// gal te de tsam mi nus na/ seng ge sgra nas nam mkha' lding gi bar gyi phyag 'tshal dang*/

phyogs dus kun nas bdag pos ma bzung ba'i// zhes pa nas/ zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas par 'gyur ro zhes pa'i bar gyi mchod pa dang*/ yid brtan mi rung 'chi bdag ni// zhes pa nas/ 'di nyid 'ba' zhig bsam pa'i rigs// zhes pa'i bar gyi sdig bshags dang*/ bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*// zhes pa man chad kyi bsngo ba'i tshig rnams bor nas lhag ma rnams ji skad bshad pa bzhin byas pas 'bring por 'gyur la/ bsdu na yan lag bdun pa thams cad kyang 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa ltar/ ji snyed su dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// zhes sogs brjod pas kyang 'grub bo// de ltar rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum po gang rung re thun gsum mam drug tu nyams su blangs na bsod nams kyi phung po tshad med pa thob par 'gyur bas/ las dang po pa rnams kyis 'bad par bya'o// 'phags pa'i nor bdun thob byed byang chub lam// yan lag bdun pa bris pa'i dge ba 'dis// gnas skabs rin chen bdun la dbang 'byor zhing*// mthar thug byang chub yan lag bdun thob shog /las dang po pa'i nyams su blang ba'i rim pa yan lag bdun pa'i cho ga chos dang bsod nams rab tu rgyas par byed pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i mkhas pa chen po chos kyi rje ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos rnam 'phyang gi lo nag pa zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni grags pa dpal bzang pos bgyis so// ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ pū dza me gha nā ma dhā ra ṇī/ bod skad du/ mchod pa'i sprin zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga wa te/ badz+ra sā ra pra marda ni/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re/ ma hā badz+re/ ma hā te badz+re/ ma hā bid+yā badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ ma hā bo dhi maṇ+ḍo pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badz+re/

sarba kar+m+ma a wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na badz+re swā hā/ gzungs sngags 'di'i cho ga ni 'di yin te/ dran pa tsam gyi mod la phyogs bcu dag na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gang gā'i klung gi bye ma'i rdul phra rab snyed la mchod pa byas par 'gyur zhing zhabs la phyag byas par 'gyur ro// me tog dang*/ bdug pa dang*/ spos dang*/ me tog phreng ba dang*/ byug pa dang*/ phye ma dang*/ gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan thams cad dang*/ gdan dang*/ gding ba dang*/ na bza' dang*/ spyan gzigs dang*/ bshos gtsang ba la sogs pa dang*/ rgyan dang*/ lhab lhub thams cad kyis mchod par 'gyur ro// sdig pa thams cad dang bral bar 'gyur zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad dang ldan par 'gyur ro// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mthong bas yang dag par dbugs 'byin par 'gyur ro// lha dang*/ klu dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ dri za dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ mi'am ci dang*/ lto 'phye chen po thams cad dang*/ lag na rdo rje la sogs pa gsang ba pa'i bdag po dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ rgyal po chen po bzhi po rnams phyi bzhin yang dag par 'brang zhing srung ba dang*/ skyob pa dang*/ sbed par byed do// 'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur te/ yon tan gyi khyad par 'di dag ni ma bsgrubs par lan cig dran pa tsam gyis 'thob par 'gyur ro// mchod pa'i sprin zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen rgyal mtshan la phyag 'tshal lo// na mo bha ga wa te rat+na ke tu rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ rat+ne rat+ne mahā rat+ne bi dza ye swā hā/ 'di brjod cing bskor ba gcig byas pa'ang dpag tu med pa byas par 'gyur ro// bskor ba'i gzungs rdzogs so// dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog gsum gyi rten la sngags 'di lan re brjod cing brkyang phyag re byas te phyag gsum byas na sde snod gsum thos pa dang*/

bsams pa dang*/ bsgoms pa'i bsod nams dang mnyam par 'gyur ro// nyi ma re rer phyag gsum gsum byas na tshe 'di nyid la mthong ba'i lam gyi ye shes kyi ting nge 'dzin 'thob par 'gyur ro// de ma thob kyi bar du mi dang mi ma yin pa dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ nad rims kyi gnod pa 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro// oṃ na mo mañju shrī ye/ na maḥsu shrī ye/ na mo ut+ta ma shrī ye swā hā/ phyag bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so// oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ rat+na ke tu rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ oṃ rat+ne rat+ne/ ma hā rat+ne bi dza ye swā hā/ zhes lan brgyad brjod pas phyag bya'o// na mas+sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwā nāṃ/ sarba tra saṃ ku su mi dā bhi dz+nyā ra si ni nastu te swā hā/ zhes lan brgyad brjod pas bstod pa bya'o/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza me gha pra sa ra sa mū he s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na kaṃ hūm̐/ zhes pas mchod pa byin gyis brlab bo/ na maḥsarba bud+dha bo dhi satwā naṃ/ sarba thā ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ sa man+ta swā hā/ zhes lan brgyad brjod pas mchod pa'i sprin 'byung ngo*// na mas+sarba bud+dha bo dhi sa twe bh+yaḥsarba bita pū ra pū ra/ a brtā a bha ye swā hā/ zhes brjod pas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ mchod pa dang nye gnas dang zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas par 'gyur ro// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
